name: The Captain's Chest
summary: Captain Hecklebury Smotts used to sail between Booty Bay and Ratchet in Kalimdor, until sea giants wrecked the ship, killed the crew and sent Smotts off in a lifeboat toward Booty Bay. The giant Gorlash took Smotts' Captain's Chest, and Smotts wants it back.

sections.title: A Ruined Captain
sections.body: Smotts says the voyages to Ratchet in Kalimdor built a successful career and a fine reputation. The sea giants ended all that: they smashed the ship, killed the crew and sent Smotts off in a lifeboat toward Booty Bay.

sections.title: The Stolen Chest
sections.body: The giant Gorlash took Smotts' Captain's Chest, saying he wanted it as a snuffbox. The chest was Smotts' favorite, with a secret compartment where the greatest treasures were stored. Smotts has heard that Gorlash roams the shore east of Booty Bay.

sections.title: Smotts' Thanks
sections.body: Smotts is overjoyed to have the chest back, and it takes some of the fire out of the anger, yet the revenge is not complete.

faq.answer: Smotts is a ship captain in Booty Bay who once sailed between there and Ratchet in Kalimdor, until sea giants smashed the ship and killed the crew.
Gorlash, one of the sea giants, took it and said he wanted it as a snuffbox.
East of Booty Bay, along the shore. That is where Smotts has heard the giant roams.

faq.q: Why does Smotts want the chest back?
aliases: why does smotts want the chest
faq.answer: It was Smotts' favorite chest, and its hidden compartment kept the greatest treasures.
